thread_analysis.thread_summary: AlpsAlpine 27BRD module — Review page re-confirmation before Submission after corrections (HFP version and model name updates from thread_0142). Key confirmations: (1) after any correction, re-capture and re-send the Review page for customer approval; (2) model names with trailing periods (e.g., '19AVNJ.') are acceptable in SIG Launchstudio.
all_questions_found: How do we re-confirm the Review page after corrections were made?
Is a model name with a trailing period acceptable for SIG registration?
Our OPP profile test is failing - how do we set up the vCard file path and physically connect the USB to a product with no exposed USB port?
Our AVRCP/CT/MCN/CB profile test is FAILing - where do we get and place a music file with metadata large enough to trigger fragmentation?
thread_analysis.key_technical_discussion: Standard pre-submission workflow: after any Qualification Workspace correction, the Review page must be re-captured and re-sent to the customer for explicit re-confirmation. Trailing periods in model names are SIG-acceptable. The thread's deeper nested history also covers profile test troubleshooting from the same project: an OPP test FAIL traced to a missing vCard sample file and an unclear USB connection method, and an AVRCP/CT/MCN/CB test FAIL traced to a missing large-metadata (>512KB) music file needed to trigger fragmentation behavior.
thread_analysis.key_decision_logic: Corrections made → re-capture Review page → send to customer → await explicit OK → submit. Model name punctuation: trailing periods are acceptable, no change required.
thread_analysis.risk_if_done_wrong: Submitting after corrections without re-confirming the Review page risks submitting content the customer has not approved in its corrected form.
thread_analysis.consulting_mistake: Submitting to SIG based on the original approval when corrections have since been made to the registration content.
thread_analysis.consulting_takeaway: Treat every correction as resetting the approval clock — always re-confirm the Review page after any change, even minor ones, before Submission.
